plain_summary: Metformin helps maintain balanced blood sugar levels by reducing glucose production in the liver and improving body sensitivity to insulin.
general_usage: Used under clinical guidance for blood sugar management.
administration_note: Commonly taken with meals to minimize stomach upset.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines (23rd List, 2023)
citation.excerpt: Metformin: Section 18.5 Medicines for diabetes. Core medicine for blood glucose management.

plain_summary: Atorvastatin helps regulate blood cholesterol levels by slowing cholesterol formation in the liver, supporting arterial and heart wellness.
general_usage: Used to maintain healthy cholesterol balance under medical supervision.
administration_note: Often taken in the evening or at bedtime as advised by clinicians.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
citation.excerpt: Atorvastatin: Lipid-lowering agent. Indicated for individuals at elevated risk of cardiovascular events.

plain_summary: Amoxicillin is an antibacterial medicine used to treat bacterial infections. Completing the prescribed course is important to prevent antibiotic resistance.
general_usage: Prescribed for specific bacterial infections as diagnosed by a clinician.
administration_note: Drink adequate water; finish the full course even if feeling better.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines (Access Group)
citation.excerpt: Amoxicillin: Access group antibiotic for respiratory and skin-soft tissue bacterial infections.

plain_summary: Azithromycin is an antibiotic that stops bacterial growth in respiratory and skin infections. It is usually prescribed for short courses of 3 to 5 days.
general_usage: Used for susceptible bacterial infections under clinical oversight.
administration_note: Take as directed, either with food or on an empty stomach depending on formulation.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
citation.excerpt: Azithromycin: Watch group antibacterial for targeted clinical indications.

plain_summary: Paracetamol is commonly used to ease mild to moderate discomfort and help lower elevated body temperature.
general_usage: Used for temporary symptom relief of mild aches and fever.
administration_note: Do not exceed maximum daily limits to protect liver health.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
citation.excerpt: Paracetamol: Section 2.1 Non-opioids and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines.

plain_summary: Omeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced by the stomach lining, helping to relieve irritation, heartburn, and acid reflux.
general_usage: Prescribed to soothe stomach acid symptoms.
administration_note: Best taken in the morning 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines

plain_summary: Amlodipine helps relax and widen blood vessels, allowing blood to circulate more smoothly and maintaining balanced blood pressure.
general_usage: Prescribed for cardiovascular blood pressure support.
administration_note: Can be taken with or without food at roughly the same time daily.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines

plain_summary: Losartan works by blocking compounds that tighten blood vessels, helping circulation flow smoothly and supporting heart function.
general_usage: Used for blood pressure balance and kidney protection in specific contexts.
administration_note: Maintain consistent daily schedule as recommended by doctor.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines

plain_summary: Pantoprazole decreases stomach acid secretion to support healing of stomach lining and relieve acidic burning sensations.
general_usage: Used to manage acid reflux symptoms under clinician care.
administration_note: Swallow whole without crushing; usually taken before first meal.

citation.source_name: National List of Essential Medicines India
citation.license_note: Govt of India Public Health Reference
citation.excerpt: Pantoprazole tablets 40 mg: Section 17 Gastrointestinal medicines.

plain_summary: Cetirizine helps block histamines, providing relief from allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, watery eyes, and itching.
general_usage: Commonly used for environmental or seasonal allergy relief.
administration_note: May cause mild drowsiness in some individuals.

citation.source_name: National List of Essential Medicines India
citation.license_note: Govt of India Public Health Reference
citation.excerpt: Cetirizine tablets 10 mg: Antiallergics and medicines used in anaphylaxis.

plain_summary: Metoprolol slows heart rate and reduces the workload on the heart muscle, supporting regular cardiac rhythm and balanced pressure.
general_usage: Prescribed for cardiovascular rhythm and blood pressure support.
administration_note: Do not abruptly discontinue without consulting your physician.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines

plain_summary: Levothyroxine supplies synthetic thyroid hormone to balance natural metabolic processes when the thyroid produces less hormone.
general_usage: Prescribed for thyroid hormone balance under clinical blood monitoring.
administration_note: Take on an empty stomach with plain water at least 30 minutes before breakfast.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
citation.excerpt: Levothyroxine: Section 18.8 Thyroid hormones and antithyroid medicines.

plain_summary: Salbutamol relaxes airway muscles to make breathing easier during episodes of wheezing, cough, or chest tightness.
general_usage: Used as a bronchodilator for airway relaxation.
administration_note: Use inhaler spacer if recommended for optimal delivery.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
citation.excerpt: Salbutamol inhaler: Section 25.1 Medicines acting on the respiratory tract.

plain_summary: Ibuprofen is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine that helps reduce inflammation, swelling, and mild aches.
general_usage: Used for temporary pain and swelling relief.
administration_note: Take with meals or milk to protect stomach lining.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
citation.excerpt: Ibuprofen: Section 2.1 Non-opioid analgesics and antipyretics.

plain_summary: Ciprofloxacin is a broad-spectrum antibiotic for targeted bacterial infections under professional clinical direction.
administration_note: Drink plenty of fluids; avoid taking simultaneously with antacids or dairy.

citation.source_name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
citation.excerpt: Ciprofloxacin: Watch group antibiotic with specific clinical stewardship guidelines.
